harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, built a 2.15 GiB LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) backed by two loop-mounted files (no spare block device existed on this VM), mounted it at /srv/data, grew it online from ~1000M to ~2.15G via vgextend+lvextend+xfs_growfs while it stayed mounted with data intact, made the setup boot-persistent (systemd loop-reattach unit + fstab dependency), and verified full recovery (changed boot_id, mount, LV size, checksums) across a real reboot of node1.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disks/partitions and found no spare block device or LVM tooling
Installed lvm2 via dnf
Created two sparse backing files under /var/lib/lvm-backing and attached them as loop devices (loop0, loop1)
pvcreate/vgcreate vgdata on loop0; lvcreate 1000M lvdata; mkfs.xfs; mounted at /srv/data
Wrote 3 random 20MB files and a sha256 checksum manifest into /srv/data
Added loop1 as a second PV, vgextend'd vgdata, lvextend'd lvdata by +1200M, and xfs_growfs'd it online (final size <2.15G) while still mounted
Verified checksums matched post-grow
Created /usr/local/sbin/setup-lvm-loops.sh and systemd unit lvm-loop-setup.service (WantedBy=sysinit.target) to reattach loop devices and activate vgdata at boot
Added /srv/data to /etc/fstab by UUID with x-systemd.requires=lvm-loop-setup.service; confirmed generated mount unit ordering
Captured pre-reboot boot_id, LV size, and checksum baseline
Issued systemctl reboot in background so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 exec was reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed, /srv/data auto-mounted with correct size, vgdata both PVs active, and checksums still verified OK

evidence.summary: Wrote 3x20MB files and sha256 checksum manifest to /srv/data
vgextend with second loop PV, lvextend +1200M, xfs_growfs while /srv/data remained mounted; resulting size <2.15G
sha256sum -c against pre-growth manifest reported all files OK, mount confirmed still active

evidence.requirement: Boot persistence setup (config only, not proof of restart)
evidence.summary: Created loop-reattach script/service and fstab entry; verified systemd generated correct Requires/After ordering for srv-data.mount
Captured boot_id 377b5195..., LV size <2.15g, and checksum OK immediately before reboot
systemctl reboot launched via backgrounded nohup so the exec call returned 'reboot issued' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out/reset during reboot, then exec succeeded again; boot_id changed from 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99 to 2c39078e-edbc-4287-af4c-a23f8e113c4d, proving an actual restart
After restart, /srv/data auto-mounted via systemd dependency chain, LV size still <2.15G, both PVs active in vgdata, and sha256sum -c reported all files OK
